newsitem.title: USA: CBOT old crop soybeans fall in volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: CBOT old crop soybeans fall in volatile trade.

text.p: CBOT old crop soybean futures fell in volatile, fast trade on liquidation of the July and on spread profit taking ahead of Friday's USDA Supply and Demand Report, pit sources said.
Traders cited liquidation of the July contract ahead of expiry on July 22. Volume was said to be thin and small-lot sell orders were enough to move the market several cents, traders said.
Trade sources noted the July/November spread widened to $1.90 a bushel, premium July, in overnight trade, the widest point since May 30 when the spread closed at $1.95-3/4.
Traders said Smith Barney sold 500,000 bushels July and Cargill Inc sold 200,000.
At 0946 CDT, soybeans were down 12 to 8-1/2 cents per bushel with July off 12 cents at $7.78 a bushel.
